content: Newegg is hosting a bundle that includes Microsoft’s wireless Xbox controller (in black) and a $50 digital Xbox gift card together for $80. Given that this model typically sits around $50 to $60 depending on the color you want, this is a fantastic value since it essentially knocks its price down to $30. Another way of thinking about it is you’re paying full price for the controller, but getting a big discount on the gift card. [Product: Xbox Wireless Controller | https://click.linksynergy.com/deeplink?id=nOD/rLJHOac&mid=44583&murl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.newegg.com%2FProduct%2FComboDealDetails%3Fsdtid%3D20043000%26ItemList%3DCombo.4887909%26Tpk%3D4887909] The controller included is a great option for Xbox or for PC. It supports Bluetooth connectivity, and it’s also a solid wireless gamepad to connect to a Steam Deck or any other gaming handheld that can be docked to a TV. While it lacks Hall effect sticks, it’s the best midrange controller from Microsoft yet, with a premium-feeling, comfortable design, a headphone jack, and good battery life (it supports swappable AA batteries). Other great Verge-approved deals * The Aurzen tri-fold mini projector is an awesome gadget. We said as much in our review, wherein Verge deputy editor Thomas Ricker used it in all sorts of scenarios to put it to the test. Normally $299, the USB-C chargeable projector is $249.99 at Best Buy for the rest of the day. Despite its small size, it’s surprisingly bright, and it easily connect to Android or iPhone so you can get to mirroring your games and other locally-stored content (or stuff that’s streamed via Plex or a similar service). Though, if it’s DRM-protected shows or movies you want to beam on your wall or makeshift surface, you’ll unfortunately need Aurzen’s pricey CastPlay Pro dongle that’s currently $105. * I don’t want to jinx our good fortune, but I’ve been finding some appealing laptop deals recently. The latest is Acer’s Chromebook Plus Spin 514, which is one of the best, most well-rounded models available. Sure, it’s no high-end Googlebook, but it’s a pretty solid laptop for $499 at Best Buy (originally $749, the discount expires later today). It has a 14-inch 1200p touchscreen with a foldable 2-in-1 design, and its specs include the MediaTek Kompanio Ultra processor, 12GB RAM, 256GB of SSD storage, Wi-Fi 7 support. Given its Chromebook Plus designation, it includes one year of free access to Google AI Pro, which grants 5TB of cloud storage, YouTube Premium Lite, Google Home Premium, and other perks. * The price keeps falling at Amazon on Ugreen’s Nexode Pro multi-port wall charger. Originally $89.99, it has almost never sold for that amount. In fact, it dropped to $49.99 briefly following its debut, and has only dropped to $59.99 — its current price — once before. This is the kind of gadget that anyone who owns multiple USB-C chargeable tech products should have. It tops out at 140W speed when you use just one of its USB-C ports, and it can divvy up 160W of total power across five gadgets that are plugged in at once.

chineseContent: Newegg 正在推出一个捆绑包，其中包括微软的无线 Xbox 控制器（黑色）和价值 50 美元的数字 Xbox 礼品卡，售价 80 美元。考虑到该型号的价格通常约为 50 至 60 美元，具体取决于您想要的颜色，这是一个非常超值的选择，因为它基本上将价格降至 30 美元。另一种思考方式是，您为控制器支付全价，但在礼品卡上获得大幅折扣。 [产品：Xbox无线控制器| https://click.linksynergy.com/deeplink?id=nOD/rLJHOac&mid=44583&murl=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.newegg.com%2FProduct%2FComboDealDetails%3Fsdtid%3D20043000%26ItemList%3DCombo.4887909%26Tpk%3D4887909]随附的控制器是 Xbox 或 PC 的绝佳选择。它支持蓝牙连接，也是一个坚固的无线游戏手柄，可以连接到 Steam Deck 或任何其他可以连接到电视的游戏手持设备。虽然它没有霍尔效应棒，但它是微软迄今为止最好的中频控制器，具有优质的感觉、舒适的设计、耳机插孔和良好的电池寿命（支持可更换的 AA 电池）。其他经 Verge 批准的超值优惠 * Aurzen 三折迷你投影仪是一款很棒的小工具。我们在评论中也说了同样的话，其中 Verge 副主编 Thomas Ricker 在各种场景中使用它来对其进行测试。 USB-C 可充电投影仪通常售价 299 美元，在百思买当天剩余时间售价为 249.99 美元。尽管尺寸很小，但它的亮度却出奇的好，并且可以轻松连接到 Android 或 iPhone，这样您就可以镜像您的游戏和其他本地存储的内容（或通过 Plex 或类似服务流式传输的内容）。不过，如果您想将受 DRM 保护的节目或电影传输到墙壁或临时表面上，那么不幸的是您需要 Aurzen 昂贵的 CastPlay Pro 加密狗。
